gameplay.diagonal_corners: Concave joins fill the empty quadrant from the diagonal solid material; never cut solid foreground pixels
gameplay.hand_attachment: Authored opaque grip per item, two bow hands, shared pose/frame joints mirrored and scaled with the actor
gameplay.compositor: actor_renderer.hpp; shared by game and tests/actor_test.cpp
gameplay.human_proportions: Compact reference-led design: voluminous thirteen-pixel head, large profile eye, short collar, ten-pixel coat torso and eight-pixel legs
gameplay.tree_connections: Eight trunk fork/root variants; foliage connects to logs; clustered background crowns share continuous stems
gameplay.outside_corners: Connected exposed-edge curves; opaque shared edges, 2px timber corners and 5px soil/stone corners
gameplay.foliage_connectivity: Connected corner squares are opaque in temperate, snow and jungle foliage

natural_trees.rendering: Trunk-anchored complete branching crown; mining mask per leaf cell; tapered trunk and root flares

gameplay.limb_layering: All limbs are authored facing +X. Rear arm and rear leg are behind the trunk/camera limbs. Camera-side main hand operates tools and draws the bowstring; support hand holds the bow handle. One whole-actor mirror on a turn.
gameplay.limb_tone: Camera-facing arm uses full skin/sleeve tone; rear skin, glove and cloth/armor cuffs use 232/255 brightness.
gameplay.leg_chain: Shared per-frame hip/knee/ankle/foot anchors drive pants, greaves and boots

arm_bones.solver: Generation-time two-bone pixel-grid solver; runtime uses the authored sprites and anchors

gameplay.animation_clocks: Travel-distance Q8 gait phase and separate start-to-finish tool action clock. Static inventory/wardrobe/dialogue previews use the stand frame.
gameplay.sprite_storage: Deduplicated indexed sprite rows; pose-independent clothes and armor reuse locomotion frames

cover.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original pixel-art sandbox game cover / square launcher artwork for Starsoil
Primary request: an original 2D side-view pixel sandbox adventure reminiscent of the detailed 16-bit aesthetic of Terraria, with entirely new characters and world. A tiny copper-armored explorer with a teal scarf holds a glowing pickaxe on a grassy cliff; a lantern-lit timber cottage and friendly gardener on the surface; cutaway underground layers show copper veins, blue crystals, roots, a treasure chest and a small turquoise slime. Lush forest on one side, ochre desert and snow-capped pines in the distance, twilight mountain silhouettes and stars. Crisp intentional pixels, limited jewel-tone palette, warm amber lamps against cool teal and indigo, visually readable at small size. Hand-crafted game art, no 3D, no photographic textures, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark. Square composition.
